description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the task count across various language families, categorized by which model performed better. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are language groups arranged alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "task count" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, where each language category contains up to three side-by-side bars representing the performance outcome, as indicated by the legend titled "better". The components are "mBERT" in light blue, "XLM-R" in dark blue, and "same" in light green, with all bars outlined in a thin black border. The values vary across categories and outcomes, with the tallest bar representing XLM-R in the IE-Slavic category, reaching a task count of approximately 39. Conversely, the shortest bars are for mBERT in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories, which have values at or near 0. Other representative values include the "same" category for IE-Romance at roughly 30, the "same" category for IE-Slavic at 28, and the XLM-R category for IE-Germanic at approximately 18. In the Uralic group, XLM-R is at 14, while mBERT and "same" are at approximately 1 and 5, respectively.
